published_artifact_evidence.calibration: importance matrix from 1000 chunks of 4096 tokens

transferable_findings: GSQ improves discrete scalar assignments and group scales while projecting the result back into standard deployment formats, so it can improve quality without earning a new HIP decoder.
RCO optimizes a non-decomposable model loss under an exact global byte budget instead of summing independent local proxy scores.
The published allocation is highly non-uniform even within one semantic role. A role supplies floors and priors; it should not hard-code one precision for every layer.
The allocation preserves hundreds of small recurrent/control tensors in BF16/F32 while varying precision over the large matrices, independently reproducing the structural lesson from Hy4.
The public RCO implementation supports grouping by layer, expert, or regex and includes a separate MoE expert-pruning application.
limitations: The reviewed artifact is a 27B dense/hybrid model, not a greater-than-300-GB MoE deployment.
The reported quality suite has no full-vocabulary terminal KL, tool-call boundary, structured-output, or Lucebox performance measurement.
GSQ's published optimization target is layer reconstruction, not K3 terminal KL.
The public RCO quantization pipeline assigns whole tensors/layers. It does not directly implement K3 route-by-slab-by-fidelity allocation.
Using RCO's non-decomposable objective on K3 requires a differentiable terminal evaluator or a validated differentiable surrogate; the current llama.cpp captured-state path is not autograd-enabled.
The exact-budget dynamic program must be proven tractable after byte discretization before expanding from representative layers to all K3 route/slab groups.
interpretation: Make GSQ-refined standard scalar formats a mandatory native/source-compatible candidate in the Lucebox codec deathmatch. Retain RCO as the preferred joint allocator only after a terminal estimator or differentiable captured-state evaluator passes the Phase B correlation gate. Do not build a new kernel or full RCO subsystem from this artifact.
